Name: (SDR) - Mega Farm
Author: klatuprism
Description:
A crazy large (200x200) expansion map for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10512]Stardew Realty[/url].  This will make your saves huge and I hope you have lots of RAM and a decent CPU/GPU.  I have grown as many as 36,000 cauliflower and my PC did not catch fire.  Fully populated with crops and Junimos can cause some stuttering, your experience may vary.

The land is wide open with no barriers.

I use this expansion with my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8715]Stardew Web[/url], to draw pictures with crops.

The expansion is available at the start of Year 3 for 20,000 gold.

You can customize the availability by editing the expansion.json file.  The file is located in the this mods top directory.  Open the expansion.json file in your favouriite text editor and modify the "Requirements" entry.  Blanking it out will make the land available at the start of the game.  You can also change the cost of the land by modifying the "Cost" entry.

Downloads.Description: Stardew 1.6 edition. Requires the latest Stardew Realty.
